events.title: Chêne
events.description: Join Chêne Gear for an evening of outdoor films, storytelling, conservation, and community at the The Carolina Theatre. Featuring a curated selection of short films from past Chêne Film Fests, the evening highlights waterfowl culture, hunting tradition, conservation, and the people who shape the outdoor community. Guests can enjoy a casual happy hour, merchandise, guest speakers, and an immersive film experience designed to bring the Charlotte outdoor community together. Inspired by the spirit of Chêne Fest, this event offers a unique night centered around film, culture, and connection. Whether it is a date night, an off-season gathering with friends, or simply a chance to connect with others who share a passion for the outdoors, we look forward to welcoming you for the evening.
